WELCOME TO THE LAB

Chase the projected lap.

The solid white car is your physical vehicle. The mint silhouette is a ghost projected onto the floor. An overhead virtual camera follows the roof marker.

W / ↑ Accelerate   S / ↓ Brake / reverse
A / D or ← / → Steer   Space Pause
R Reset   Drag in Lab view to orbit · Scroll to zoom

Complete the circuit in order to record a lap. Leaving the circuit invalidates that lap. Return to the start for a fresh attempt.

This is a browser simulation of a projection installation. The ghost is synthetic, the marker and camera tracking are visual simulations, and speed is scaled to full-size race-car units.
